source.title: EvoTS-Agent: A Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Financial Time Series Change Point Detection

comparison.stagnation_rule: A Revision is marked stagnant when its validation improvement is <= epsilon or invalid; an unused stagnant revision triggers Alternative Strategy at the next non-final optimization iteration.
comparison.incumbent_rule: Candidate is accepted only if its validation F1 is valid and strictly exceeds the incumbent; acceptance and stagnation are independent.

outer_eval_protocol.paper_statement: Reference boundaries are available only on validation during optimization; test-set annotations and metrics remain hidden throughout optimization.
outer_eval_protocol.classification: paper-protocol selection-hidden outer evaluation with residual reporting ambiguity because Table 3 itself does not explicitly say 'test' in the caption

supports: Within this Bee-Dance/GPT-5.4 setting, allowing stagnation-triggered Alternative Strategy improves mean F1 relative to the reported no-Alternative variant.
The paper separates optimization feedback from a chronological test split and states test annotations/metrics are hidden during optimization.
Strategy reopening and final recombination contribute independently to F1 in the reported ablation, though Hausdorff distance moves in the opposite direction.
does_not_support: A four-way Stop vs Continue-fixed vs Widen vs Reopen causal comparison.
Exact total-compute matching between full and ablated conditions; the paper reports the operator ablation but this run did not source-bind an implementation proving identical token/tool cost.
Anytime-valid candidate acceptance or proposal-crossing statistical error spending.
Complete proposal chronology or restart-durable promotion evidence.
Generalization of the F1 benefit beyond the exact dataset/backbone/operator budget tested.

searched_public_surfaces: web search for Figure 4 / Heilbronn / Beam Search / Best-of-N / Top-K / MAP-Elites launchers and logs
evox_provenance_followup.guard: Do not substitute current default initializer or current seed for historical Figure 4a.

exact_next_action: Locate an official EvoTS-Agent executable/results artifact and source-bind Table-3 evaluation split, no-Alternative operator substitution, optimization/evaluation budgets, seeds and full proposal chronology. In parallel continue searching for a same-system Stop/Continue-fixed/Widen/Reopen comparison under equal proposal/evaluation budgets with a genuinely untouched outer test; audit candidate-local anytime-valid acceptance, restart-durable cross-proposal spending, immutable promotion identity and feedback bandwidth.
